title: Isaiah 46
paragraphs: ¹ Bel bows down, Nebo stoops low; their idols are loaded onto beasts and cattle. The things you carry are burdens to weary animals. ² They stoop and bow down together; unable to bear the load, they are carried off into captivity. ³ 'Listen to me, house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, you whom I have upheld since your birth and carried since you were born. ⁴ Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he; I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you. ⁵ To whom will you compare me or count me equal? To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?'

⁶ Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it. ⁷ They lift it to their shoulders and carry it; they set it up in its place, and there it stands. It cannot move from where it is. Someone cries out to it, but it never answers; it cannot save them from their troubles. ⁸ 'Remember this and stand firm; take it to heart, you rebels. ⁹ Remember the former things long past, for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me. ¹⁰ I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say: my purpose will stand, and I will do all that I please.'

¹¹ 'I call a bird of prey from the east — the man from a far country who carries out my purpose. What I have said, I will bring about; what I have planned, I will do. ¹² Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, you who are far from my saving justice. ¹³ I am bringing my justice near; it is not far away, and my salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, my splendor to Israel.'
